We're looking for a senior technical leader to head our DevSecOps function in India. You'll be responsible for infrastructure, security operations, and platform engineering across our India office (~150 employees), working closely with our UK-based security and operations leadership.

This is a hands-on leadership role. We need someone who can architect solutions, troubleshoot at the command line, write code, and lead by examplenot someone who delegates everything and manages from spreadsheets.

Location : Remote

Employment Type Full-time, Permanent

Key Responsibilities

Infrastructure & Cloud Operations

Own and operate cloud infrastructure across Azure (primary) and AWS

Manage environments ranging from 5 VMs to 50+ VMs per project

Design, build, and maintain all Infrastructure as Code using Terraform

Manage Windows and Mac endpoint estate across India office

Capacity planning, cost optimisation, and performance tuning

Security Operations

Implement and enforce security policies across infrastructure and endpoints

Own vulnerability management lifecycle from scanning through remediation

Lead incident response and conduct post-incident reviews

Maintain compliance posture and audit readiness

Team Leadership

Build, mentor, and performance-manage the India operations team

Conduct technical training and upskilling for junior team members

Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and knowledge base
Cross-functional Collaboration

Work directly with UK-based DevOps and CISO leadership (expect direct, demanding communication style)

Act as escalation point for all India infrastructure and security issues

Support development teams with environments, pipelines, and platform needs

Required Technical Experience

Microsoft Azure (Essential Primary Cloud)

Minimum 5 years hands-on production experience. You must be able to demonstrate practical, working knowledge of:

Compute: Provisioning and managing Virtual Machines, VM Scale Sets, availability sets, fault domains. Troubleshooting boot diagnostics, serial console access, extension failures

Networking: Designing and implementing VNets, subnets, NSGs, ASGs, UDRs. Configuring VNet peering, VPN Gateways (S2S and P2S), ExpressRoute basics, Azure Firewall or NVAs, Private Endpoints, Private Link, DNS zones (public and private)

Identity: Entra ID (Azure AD) administrationusers, groups, conditional access policies, PIM, enterprise app registrations, service principals, managed identities. Hybrid identity with AD Connect

Storage: Blob, File, Queue, Table storage. Lifecycle policies, access tiers, SAS tokens, RBAC vs access keys, Azure File Sync

Security: Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Servers, Defender for Endpoint. Configuring security policies, regulatory compliance dashboards, secure score remediation, Key Vault (secrets, keys, certificates, access policies vs RBAC)

Monitoring: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics workspaces, KQL queries, diagnostic settings, metric alerts, action groups, workbooks. Application Insights for supporting dev teams

Governance: Management groups, subscriptions, resource groups, Azure Policy (built-in and custom), Blueprints, Cost Management, tagging strategies, RBAC role assignments and custom role definitions
You will be asked to whiteboard or verbally walk through architectures you have personally designed and explain your decisions.

Amazon Web Services (Required Secondary Cloud)
Minimum 2 years hands-on production experience. You must demonstrate working knowledge of:

Compute: EC2 instance lifecycle, AMI management, launch templates, Auto Scaling Groups, ELB/ALB/NLB configuration and troubleshooting

Networking: VPC design, subnets (public/private), route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Security Groups, NACLs, VPC peering, Transit Gateway basics

Identity: IAM users, groups, roles, policies (managed and inline). Cross-account access, instance profiles, service-linked roles. IAM policy troubleshooting

Storage: S3 bucket policies, lifecycle rules, versioning, replication. EBS volume types, snapshots, encryption

Security: AWS Config, Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail. KMS key management

Monitoring: CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, dashboards. Log group retention, metric filters

Terraform (Essential)
Minimum 4 years hands-on production experience writing and maintaining Terraform. You must demonstrate:

Writing Terraform from scratchnot just modifying existing code

State management: Remote backends (Azure Storage, S3), state locking, handling state file corruption, state mv/rm/import commands, when and how to use them safely

Code structure: Organising code into reusable modules, when to use modules vs flat code, module versioning strategies, mono-repo vs multi-repo approaches

Variables and outputs: Input validation, locals, output usage across modules, sensitive variables

Resource lifecycle: Understanding of create/update/destroy behaviours, lifecycle blocks (prevent_destroy, ignore_changes, create_before_destroy), handling resource drift

Provisioners and workarounds: When to use (and avoid) provisioners, null_resource, local-exec, remote-exec

Workspaces: When to use workspaces vs separate state files, workspace limitations

CI/CD integration: Running Terraform in pipelines, plan/apply workflows, handling secrets, approval gates

Troubleshooting: Reading and interpreting plan output, debugging provider issues, handling dependency errors, recovering from failed applies
Candidates must provide examples of Terraform code they have personally written. Copy-pasted modules from public registries without customisation do not count.

CI/CD Pipelines (Essential)
Minimum 4 years hands-on production experience building and maintaining pipelines. You must demonstrate:

Azure DevOps (Essential):

Writing YAML pipelines from scratchstages, jobs, steps, dependencies, conditions

Configuring and managing self-hosted agents (Windows and Linux), agent pools, agent capabilities

Variable groups, pipeline variables, secret management, Key Vault integration

Artifact publishing and consumption across pipelines

Service connectionscreating, securing, troubleshooting authentication failures

Release pipelines (classic) and environment approvals in YAML pipelines

Pipeline triggersCI, PR, scheduled, pipeline completion triggers

Troubleshooting failed buildsreading logs, identifying agent vs code vs configuration issues

Template reuseextending templates, passing parameters

Also required:

Integrating security scanning tools into pipelines (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container scanning)

Git workflowsbranching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based), pull request policies, merge conflict resolution

Secrets management in pipelineswhy you never hardcode secrets, how to rotate them

GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI experience is a plus but Azure DevOps is non-negotiable.
Candidates will be asked to describe a complex pipeline they built, including how they handled failures, rollbacks, and security.

Windows Server Administration (Essential)
Minimum 5 years hands-on production experience. You must demonstrate:

Active Directory: Designing and managing AD structureOUs, GPOs, group nesting strategy, delegation. Troubleshooting replication issues, DVIR/SYSVOL, DNS integration with AD. AD Sites and Services for multi-site environments

Group Policy: Creating and troubleshooting GPOs, precedence and inheritance, security filtering, WMI filters, loopback processing, gpresult/rsop troubleshooting

DNS/DHCP: Configuring and troubleshooting Windows DNSforward/reverse zones, conditional forwarders, delegation, scavenging. DHCP scopes, reservations, options, failover

File Services: NTFS vs share permissions, DFS namespaces and replication, quotas, FSRM

Server management: Server roles installation and configuration, Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) or alternative patching solutions, troubleshooting services, event log analysis, performance monitoring (perfmon, resource monitor)

PowerShell: Writing scripts for automationnot just running scripts others wrote. Must be able to demonstrate scripting ability for user provisioning, system reporting, bulk operations

Troubleshooting: Systematic approach to diagnosing issuesevent logs, network traces, process monitor, dependency analysis

Mac Administration (Required)
Minimum 2 years hands-on experience managing Mac devices in an enterprise environment:

MDM experienceJamf Pro, Kandji, Mosyle, or Intune for Mac

macOS deploymentDEP/ABM, automated enrolment, PreStage configurations

Profile managementconfiguration profiles, restrictions, certificate deployment

Patch management and application deployment (PKG, DMG, App Store apps via MDM)

FileVault management and recovery key escrow

Integration with Entra ID or other identity providers

Basic command-line proficiencyTerminal, common macOS commands, log locations

Networking (Essential)
Solid foundational knowledge requiredyou don't need to be a network engineer but must understand:

OSI model and how to use it for troubleshooting

IP addressing, subnetting (calculate subnets without a calculator), CIDR notation

TCP vs UDP, common port numbers, how to troubleshoot connectivity issues

DNS resolution process, common DNS issues and how to diagnose

Firewallsstateful vs stateless, rule ordering, logging and troubleshooting

VPNssite-to-site vs point-to-site, IPSec basics, troubleshooting tunnel isses

Load balancinglayer 4 vs layer 7, health probes, session persistence

Network troubleshooting toolsping, traceroute, nslookup/dig, telnet/nc, tcpdump/Wireshark basics

Security (Essential)
Minimum 4 years hands-on security operations experience:

Vulnerability management: Running and interpreting scans (Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7, Defender), prioritising remediation, tracking closure, reporting to stakeholders

Endpoint security: Deploying and managing EDR/XDR solutions, investigating alerts, tuning false positives, understanding MITRE ATT&CK basics

Patching: Designing and operating patching cycles for servers and endpoints, handling exceptions, emergency patching processes

Incident response: Hands-on experience responding to security incidentsnot just reading playbooks. Containment, eradication, recovery, post-incident review

Identity security: MFA implementation and troubleshooting, conditional access design, privileged access management, service account security

Compliance: Working knowledge of at least one frameworkISO 27001, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials, GDPR technical controls. Audit preparation and evidence gathering

Security tooling: SIEM experience (Sentinel, Splunk, or similar)writing queries, creating alerts, investigating incidents

Leadership & Communication Requirements
This is not optional. We need evidence of:

Mentoring: Specific examples of developing junior team members' skills over time. What did they learn? How did you teach them? What was the outcome?

Documentation: Examples of runbooks, knowledge bases, or training materials you have personally created

Cross-cultural communication: Experience working with UK, US, or European teams. Understanding of direct communication styles and ability to not take blunt feedback personally

Stakeholder management: Experience working with demanding, senior technical stakeholders who will challenge your decisions and expect detailed justifications

Pushing back: Ability to say no with evidence, escalate appropriately, and advocate for your team without being defensive

Calm under pressure: Examples of handling outages, security incidents, or difficult situations while remaining professional

Thanks & Regards,
Shyamala.A
Adappt Mobile Cloud Applications Pvt Ltd

8+ years of experience in applying data science methods to develop models that extract business value from real-world data. Experience in Energy & Utilities domain or financial risk/ commodities pricing /trading would be a plus.

Deep familiarity with a range of data science methods and algorithms (time-series analysis, regression analysis, experimental design, optimization, etc.)

Working at Moative
Moative is a young company, but we believe strongly in thinking long-term, while acting with urgency. Our ethos is rooted in innovation, efficiency and high-quality outcomes. We believe the future of work is AI-augmented and boundary less. Here are some of our guiding principles:
Think in decades. Act in hours. As an independent company, our moat is time. While our decisions are for the long-term horizon, our execution will be fast measured in hours and days, not weeks and months.
Own the canvas. Throw yourself in to build, fix or improve anything that isn’t done right, irrespective of who did it. Be selfish about improving across the organization – because once the rot sets in, we waste years in surgery and recovery.
Use data or don’t use data. Use data where you ought to but not as a ‘cover-my-back’ political tool. Be capable of making decisions with partial or limited data. Get better at intuition and pattern-matching. Whichever way you go, be mostly right about it.
Avoid work about work. Process creeps on purpose, unless we constantly question it. We are deliberate about committing to rituals that take time away from the actual work. We truly believe that a meeting that could be an email, should be an email and you don’t need a person with the highest title to say that loud.
High revenue per person. We work backwards from this metric. Our default is to automate instead of hiring. We multi-skill our people to own more outcomes than hiring someone who has less to do. We don’t like squatting and hoarding that comes in the form of hiring for growth. High revenue per person comes from high quality work from everyone. We demand it.

Strategic mindset with the ability to execute at both technical and leadership levels.
Strong communicator who can translate complex data concepts into business value.
Passion for improving education through data and technology.

As a member of an innovative team of IT professionals, you will work closely with talented engineers and product owners across the globe to deploy and support enterprise applications that are used to run our business at Pega. Pega has enhanced the way customers manage and experience their applications. Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues during environment setup or migration.

Bachelors degree in engineering or related field.

description:
JOB QUALIFICATIONS
Education : Bachelor s degree in data science/analytics or Engineering in Computer Science, or related quantitative field. Master s degree preferred.
Experience :
At least 5+ years of experience in the field of Data Analytics/Engineering.
Proven track record of leading data engineering initiatives or mentoring junior data engineers.
Technical Skills :
Architecting scalable data solutions across cloud platforms.
Advanced performance tuning and optimization of data pipelines.
Experience with enterprise-level data goverce frameworks.
Leadership in CI/CD and DevOps practices for data engineering.
Mentorship experience or team leadership in agile environments.
Experience with data pipeline tools (e.g., Apache Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, Fabric, Informatica).
Proficient in SQL and Python/PySpark for complex data transformations and automation
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (Fabric or AWS) and data warehouses (Snowflake or Synapse) for large-scale data integration and analysis
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric and its integration within modern data ecosystems
Strong understanding of data modelling, schema design, and performance tuning
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems like Git
Soft Skills :
Strong analytical skills; capable of multi-tasking in fast-paced, dynamic environment
Strong written and verbal communication, including report writing and data storytelling
Stay updated with industry trends and evolving tools; Demonstrate a proactive approach to learning new techniques and technologies
Work effectively across cross-functional teams
Strong stakeholder management and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Experience presenting technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive consensus.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES
Model Development Deployment:
Develop predictive models to forecast key sales and marketing metrics solve to complex business problems and drive strategic insights.
Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of data science projects, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, and deployment.
Lead and architect predictive modeling frameworks.
Review and guide model development by junior team members.
Design and implement scalable analytics platforms.
Drive strategic data initiatives in collaboration with fice and business leaders.
Data Analysis Insights:
Analyze large, complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that inform decision-making.
Collaborate with fice and accounting teams to automate reconciliations, variance analysis, and error detection using advanced analytics and machine learning.
Innovation, Automation Generative AI:
Lead initiatives leveraging Generative AI (GenAI) technologies to automate the generation of ficial reports, narratives, and data summaries, enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
Lead GenAI strategy for data engineering and analytics automation.
Evaluate and implement emerging technologies to enhance data workflows.
Explore and implement GenAI applications to improve natural language processing (NLP) capabilities for extracting insights from unstructured ficial documents (e.g., contracts, invoices).
Drive the adoption of GenAI-powered chatbots or virtual assistants to support fice shared services teams with data queries, process guidance, and routine task automation.
OTHER DUTIES
Support Data Infrastructure Goverce:
Lead efforts to design, optimize, and scale data infrastructure in Microsoft Fabric, defining clear data requirements and overseeing robust ETL/ELT processes.
Drive data goverce initiatives by implementing data quality frameworks, ensuring thorough documentation, and standardizing practices across teams to maintain data integrity.
Enhance Reporting Analytics Standards:
Collaborate with analytics and BI teams to establish dashboard design standards, improve user experience, and ensure consistent KPI definitions across the organization.
Promote a Data-Driven Culture:
Advocate for a data-driven culture, promoting the value of analytics in strategic and operational decision-making.
Lead or support analytical training sessions or workshops for non-technical stakeholders to improve data literacy across the organization.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
Partner with business, product, and operational teams to provide expert data engineering support, enabling effective data-driven solutions and innovation across departments.

description:
The Data Governance Data Privacy Lead will define and operationalize data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks for enterprise Data Product implementation This role ensures that data products are trusted, compliant, secure-by-design , and aligned with regulatory, risk, and enterprise data standards while enabling business agility and reuse
Key Responsibilities
Data Governance (Core)
Define and implement Data Governance operating model for Data Products / Data Mesh (ownership, stewardship, RACI)
Establish data policies, standards, and controls across data lifecycle (create, ingest, process, publish, consume)
Drive data product certification processes (quality, compliance, reusability)
Define and govern data contracts , schemas, metadata, lineage, and SLAs
Partner with CDAO, Architecture, Risk, and Legal teams for governance sign-offs
Data Privacy Compliance
Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, DPDP, etc as applicable)
Define PII classification, tagging, and handling standards for data products
Establish privacy-by-design and security-by-design controls in data pipelines
Own and drive data access controls, consent management, and entitlement models
Support regulatory audits , privacy impact assessments (DPIA), and risk reviews
Data Quality Controls
Define data quality dimensions, thresholds, and control checks (accuracy, completeness, timeliness, consistency)
Implement data quality monitoring, exception management, and remediation workflows
Partner with data engineering teams to embed automated controls into pipelines
Operating Model Enablement
Work closely with Data Product Managers and Domain teams to embed governance into delivery workflows
Enable self-service data consumption while enforcing guardrails
Drive change management, training, and adoption of governance practices
Define and track governance KPIs (quality scores, adoption, compliance)

Strong experience in Data Governance, Data Privacy, and Regulatory Compliance
Hands-on exposure to Data Product / Data Mesh implementations
Deep understanding of enterprise data architecture, data lakes, and analytics platforms

Recovery & Business Continuity
Ensure reliable recovery of files, folders, and systems across supported storage platforms.

Maintain detailed recovery documentation and conduct regular testing for compliance and effectiveness.
Collaborate with stakeholders to minimize downtime and maintain business continuity during recovery operations.

Create and manage Nasuni volumes and connectivity requirements for applications and users.

Document procedures and ensure compliance with organizational standards for access and security.

Support hardening of all storage systems according to security best practices.
Manage access controls and permissions across platforms.
Maintain and test data retention policies to comply with legal, regulatory, and organizational requirements (GDPR, HIPAA, SOX).
Performance & Optimization
Monitor storage infrastructure performance and capacity.
Generate and analyze reports to forecast future needs.
Implement optimizations to improve efficiency, performance, and cost-effectiveness.

Assist in troubleshooting complex backup and storage-related issues.
Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, and application teams to deliver integrated solutions.
Participate in on-call rotation for critical issues outside business hours.
Assist in creating and executing data migration plans, including M&A scenarios.
Support migration activities across multiple storage systems (Windows, Nasuni, Synology, Netgear, etc.).
Review migration plans with stakeholders and validate post-migration success.
100% Remote, US Time zone working mostly in US PST.

The Staff Data Products Manager & Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE) Lead is a vital hybrid role. This leader is responsible for maximizing the business value derived from the enterprise data assets and ensuring the scalable, secure, and cost-efficient operation of the Databricks Lakehouse and Data Intelligence Platform.
This role will define, shape, and drive the future of data products development; from raw data collection to high-value AI insights; whilst establishing the governance frameworks, solution delivery, operational standards, and comprehensive organizational literacy programs required for enterprise-wide data excellence.
The role acts as the leader of the organization s strategic data assets for Corporate functions and the platform operating model, generating efficiency gains via the CoE that unlocks velocity and speed-to-market for high-value, governed data products.
This position mandates the integration of two traditionally separate leadership roles, requiring deep systems thinking and a people-first approach to technical enablement.
Strategic Data Products Ownership (Vision & Value):
Define the long-term data products vision, detailed roadmap, and comprehensive corporate solutions development strategy for all data products and resulting AI insights. Own the full product lifecycle, from ideation and requirements definition to development, launch, and post-launch optimization. Act as the primary interface, collaborating with technical experts to translate complex technical capabilities into business use cases and balancing stakeholder expectations against existing development capacity and priority. Establish frameworks to set, track, and measure Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) throughout the data products lifecycle.
Databricks CoE Leadership & Governance (Scale & Security):
Design and launch the Databricks Center of Excellence (CoE). Establish and maintain the architectural governance framework, collaborating with data architecture to mandate standards such as Medallion Architecture and defining acceptable architectural patterns. Oversee the implementation and governance of Unity Catalog, defining best practices for administering identities, configuring security, managing compute resources, and securing data access within the Lakehouse. Define the Solution Qualification process for technical review audits and criteria that all new data products must meet before production deployment.
Platform Operations and MLOps:
Mandate and enforce operational excellence principles, including the use of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for all environment deployments. Establish organizational standards for CI/CD implementation and Source Code Management (SCM) . utilizing Databricks GitLab folders. Manage platform cost efficiency by establishing and enforcing policies for compute resource capacity, service limits, quotas, and utilization to measurably reduce execution costs (FinOps). Collaborate with AI governance to define the MLOps lifecycle to ensure AI models are managed, monitored, and continuously updated using tools like MLflow.
Organizational Enablement and Literacy:
Develop and execute scalable enablement programs that strengthen technical depth. Design and deploy a tiered Data Literacy Program tailored to various roles (executives, managers, technical teams). Drive internal credentialing, mandating certifications, such as the Databricks Accredited Platform Administrator.

Qualifications
Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience). Must drive internal credentialing, mandating the Databricks certifications for technical staff involved in platform configuration.
10-12 years experience with a minimum of 7+ years of progressive experience in Product Management, with a dedicated focus on enterprise SaaS, developer platforms, or data-intensive products. Proven success in defining, launching, and iterating upon complex data products, data governance programs, or technical Centers of Excellence that drove measurable business
Deep and practical familiarity with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform, including core components like Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, and MLflow. Expertise in modern data architecture patterns (Data Mesh, Medallion Architecture). Fluency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and experience implementing enterprise-level CI/CD pipelines. Strong working knowledge of identity administration, data encryption, access controls, and security configurations within a Databricks/Cloud environment, leveraging Unity Catalog.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect specializing in Configure Price Quote (CPQ) and Billing/Revenue Management solutions. This role is fully focused on post-sales delivery: owning solution design, implementation leadership, and ensuring customers realize value from our platform.

As the Solution Architect, you will lead discovery, translate business requirements into scalable solution designs, guide configuration and integration, and serve as the technical expert throughout implementation. You will collaborate closely with customers, project managers, and technical teams to deliver complex CPQ and billing solutions that support pricing, quoting, subscription billing, usage/rating, and revenue recognition.

We operate in a high-growth environment where processes evolve and priorities shift as we scale so you should be comfortable working in a startup-style setting while still bringing structure and best practices to our delivery approach.

Key Responsibilities
Solution Design & Delivery
Lead post-sales discovery to understand business processes, pricing models, quoting workflows, billing requirements, and integration needs.
Design end-to-end CPQ + Billing architectures, including data models, integrations, customizations, and reporting.
Produce implementation assets: solution design documentation, configuration workbooks, data mapping, and integration specifications.
Own technical decisions throughout the project, ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with platform best practices.
Implementation Leadership
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer after contract signature.
Partner with project management to drive delivery timelines, scope, risk mitigation, and customer expectations.
Support configuration, testing, deployment, and go-live activities.
Facilitate customer enablement and knowledge transfer to ensure long-term success.
Integration & Data
Design and support integrations between CPQ/Billing platforms and CRM, ERP, and payment gateways.
Provide guidance on data migration strategy, data validation, and cutover planning.
Customer Success
Act as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them operationalize complex pricing, subscription management, invoicing, and revenue recognition processes.
Identify risks early, propose solutions, and maintain a collaborative relationship with customers.
Contribute to continuous improvement of implementation methodology, reusable assets, templates, and best practices.
Team Enablement
Support and mentor junior consultants and configuration specialists.
Encourage a culture of shared learning, documentation, and continuous improvement.


What Youll Bring:
8+ years of experience delivering and implementing CPQ, Billing, or revenue management solutions (Salesforce CPQ/Billing, Oracle CPQ, Zuora, NetSuite, etc.).
Demonstrated success as a solution/technical lead on complex delivery projects.
Strong understanding of CRM CPQ Billing ERP data flows, including subscription lifecycle and revenue processes.
Experience designing and implementing API-based integrations and middleware patterns.
Ability to translate business processes into system capabilities and communicate trade-offs and design decisions to stakeholders.
Comfortable working in a fast-moving, evolving environment where processes are still maturing and customer use cases are complex.


Bonus Points (optional):
Knowledge of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition.
Background with subscription billing, usage metering, and rating engines.
Relevant platform certifications (e.g., Salesforce CPQ Specialist, Salesforce Billing, Zuora).
Experience in SaaS, high-growth, or startup environments.


What We Offer:
Competitive compensation and benefits that reward your talent and impact.
Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance
A front-row seat in the Silicon Valley tech ecosystem , where youll work on cutting-edge challenges shaping the future of SaaS, finance, and payments.
The opportunity to build truly groundbreaking products your work wont just support the business; it will influence how companies around the world monetize and grow.
A high-energy, collaborative culture where smart, supportive teammates push each other to learn fast, think boldly, and do the best work of their careers.
